Python standalone notice evidence — CPython 3.12.12, PBS 20251014

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt contains 23 exact upstream permission/notice texts. PYTHON.json is extracted from the publisher's SHA256-verified full 20251014 pgo+lto archive. provenance.json records hashes, publisher URLs, its static/system extension link mappings and the release source-input pins. install-match-evidence.json records component identity comparisons with the pre-bundle toolchain and signed prototype app.

Tcl, Tk, Thread and Itcl binaries in the original local toolchain match the SHA256-verified stripped PBS release; the bundled versions differ after app processing/signing. Tcl/Tk scripts and Thread/Itcl scripts match version-pinned source files. Thread 2.8.9 and Itcl 4.2.4 texts are taken directly from the SHA256-verified Tcl 8.6.14 source package, not assumed from the generic Tcl text. The PBS metadata has an outdated thread2.8.7 directory and references a missing zlib-ng license, while zlib is recorded as a system link. Both discrepancies remain documented in provenance.json.

The standalone libpython UUID is the same across the official stripped release, original toolchain, and app; all 15 file-backed sections have identical payload hashes. The differing load commands are LC_ID_DYLIB, LC_CODE_SIGNATURE and the __LINKEDIT segment size; this establishes section-payload association, not full binary identity or unsectioned data. This material is runtime notice/source evidence only. Other Python wheels, native components, models, and delivery obligations require their own review.
